newsitem.title: USA: Coda Music Q1 sales jump helps trim loss.
newsitem.headline: Coda Music Q1 sales jump helps trim loss.

text.p: Coda Music Technology Inc said Wednesday a 29-percent increase in revenues helped narrow its loss in the first quarter ended March 31.
The proprietary music technology developer said it lost $146,976, or $0.03 a share, in the period, an improvement on the $559,973, or $0.13, it lost in the same period last year.
Fueled by sales of its Vivace Intelligent Accompaniment product and its Finale music notation product, total sales climbed to $1.6 million from $1.3 million, Coda Music said.
The company also said more music publishers are using Finale as the standard to edit and archive sheet music, even further establishing Finale as the industry leader.
Coda Music shares closed up 5/64 Wednesday at 1-45/64.
